title: Thomas Blackshear
description: THOMAS BLACKSHEAR, a well-known commemorative plate artist, painted this collage (front) for a STAR WARS 10th anniversary plate from Hamilton Collection. He also painted the images on a full series of eight collectible plates for Hamilton. Coming full circle, Tom Jung, artist for the first STAR WARS theatrical poster, illustrated this cover (back) for the best-selling novel, "Heir to the Empire," part one of a Timothy Zahn trilogy that expands the STAR WARS universe.
